image_description: A close-up, underwater shot of a grey whale's head and rostrum. The image highlights the textured, mottled grey skin covered in barnacles (callosities) and whale lice. The lower jaw is visible with a glimpse of cream-colored baleen plates. The background is murky green water.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a tight close-up of the snout/rostrum tip; the top of the head containing the blowholes is outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture clearly shows the characteristic mottling and raised white/grey callosities typical of grey whales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal area is not visible in this head-focused crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the head is visible; the full body shape cannot be assessed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with the Head checkpoint; the visible skin matches the description perfectly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Cream-colored structures resembling baleen are visible between the upper and lower jaw on the left side.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are not visible in this head shot.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: High-resolution detail confirms rough, bumpy skin texture consistent with callosities.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness/blurring at the very edge of the lower jaw where it meets the water, potentially indicating minor generation smoothing or focus issues, though likely within acceptable photographic limits for underwater shots.
The background is extremely uniform green noise, lacking natural particulate matter variation often seen in real underwater photography, suggesting possible AI simplification.
